📄 Leader expresses condolences over passing of Grand Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei has expressed condolences over the passing of Grand Ayatollah Hossein Vahid Khorasani, describing him as one of the main pillars of teaching jurisprudence and principles of Islamic jurisprudence in Iran’s seminaries.

Ayatollah Khamenei issued a message of condolence on Wednesday, a day after the prominent cleric passed away.
​
The following is the full text of the Leader’s message, published on his official Telegram account.
​
In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful
​
I’ve received news of the passing of the great teacher in the Islamic seminary, Grand Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani. He was one of the principal pillars in teaching Islamic jurisprudence (fiqh) and the principles of jurisprudence (usul) in the Islamic seminary. In recent decades, his two daily classes were regarded to be some of the key scholarly gatherings. In addition to his own scholarly investigations, these lessons clearly reflected his profound, earnest, appreciative attention to the views of some of the most distinguished scholars of recent generations in the Islamic seminary of Najaf al-Ashraf, as well as his mastery of their thought. Combined with this magnanimous teacher’s consistently eloquent, structured, rigorous discussions, this made every lesson a beneficial, invaluable hour for those seeking knowledge and scholarly excellence.
​
Today, a substantial number of instructors and scholars in the Islamic seminary of Qom, and even in other seminaries throughout the country, along with a number of clerics in various towns, proudly cite the honor of having attended his lectures in their academic records. Everyone speaks with admiration of the profound, pure manifestation of devotion to the sacred Infallibles (pbut) witnessed in his speech and conduct. Undoubtedly, his tireless, unceasing efforts in serving the Sharia and the Shia faith have placed the community of believers and the Islamic seminaries under an immense debt of gratitude to him, which we must all remember and be thankful for.
​
I offer my condolences for this grievous loss to our Master [Imam Mahdi (may God hasten his noble reappearance)], to the Islamic seminaries, to all believers, and especially to his honorable family. I beseech God, the Glorious and Exalted, to raise that magnanimous figure to the highest ranks (in the Hereafter).

📄 Parliament amends bill on Iran’s accession to Mecca Pact

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iranian lawmakers have approved amendments to a bill on the government’s accession to the Mecca Pact.

The amendments were approved during an open session of Parliament on Wednesday, held in both virtual and in-person formats.
​
The changes were made to address concerns raised by the Guardian Council, a 12-member body that oversees legislation passed by Parliament.
​
Lawmakers approved the amendments following a report by Parliament’s Legal and Judicial Commission, which addressed the Guardian Council’s concerns.
​
The Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, known as the Mecca Pact, was signed by Pakistan, Turkiye, and Saudi Arabia on August 7, 2026.

🔊 Qatar says diplomatic efforts continue to secure Iran-US agreement

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Qatar’s Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani has reaffirmed his country’s commitment to diplomatic efforts aimed at reaching a comprehensive agreement between Iran and the United States, saying such an accord could help establish lasting peace in the region.

The Qatari official made the remarks during a phone conversation with Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of Jordan Ayman Safadi, according to a statement published by Qatar’s Foreign Ministry early Wednesday.
​
The two officials discussed the latest regional developments, as well as bilateral relations between Doha and Amman. Their talks also focused on ongoing diplomatic initiatives and coordination to ease tensions and strengthen regional security and stability.
​
Al Thani stressed Qatar’s support for all diplomatic efforts that could pave the way for a comprehensive and far-reaching agreement between Tehran and Washington, with the aim of securing lasting peace across the region.
